name: Qtaro
source:
Forced out of its pod, this dolphin is often found swimming with Chisa.
Having developed an attachment to Chisa, he usually swims right over as she gets into the water, but he also has a prankster-like side and tends to mess with her a lot, too.
He has a habit of suddenly deluging people close by with water.
